cover_headline: Samvat 2082 Ends in Red: 83 Large-Caps Fall Up to 60% as Small-Caps Mint Multibaggers

end.headline: Samvat 2082 Ends in Red: 83 Large-Caps Fall Up to 60% as Small-Caps Mint Multibaggers
end.line: India's benchmark Nifty fell about 11 percent over Samvat 2082, with 83 large-cap stocks losing ground — some by up to 60 percent — while 60 small-cap stocks more than doubled.

facts: The Nifty 50 fell about 11 percent over the Samvat year, with 83 large-cap stocks in the red and only 43 gainers
Sixty small-cap stocks more than doubled over the year, with the best performers gaining as much as 650 percent
Large-cap mutual funds fell an average of 9.34 percent over the same period
